remarks: Charm and Serenity  This light-filled home blends elegance, comfort, and versatility on a picturesque park-like acre. A custom two-tier deck is perfect for gatherings, while the three-season enclosed porch offers a peaceful retreat. Inside, deep-set windows fill the home with warmth and natural light. The cathedral-ceiling living room, featuring a fireplace and bow window, flows into a dining room with custom-lit built-ins, ideal for displaying art and china. The eat-in kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and ample storage, making entertaining a breeze. The spacious family room includes a powder room and opens to a fully equipped custom greenhouse-a rare and exciting feature for plant lovers. Upstairs, you'll find four generously sized bedrooms and two full baths, including the primary suite. This serene sanctuary boasts custom closets, hardwood floors, and a tranquil ambiance, making it the perfect place to escape the stresses of the day. A rare opportunity to own a home that offers exceptional space, style, and comfort in a sought-after location. Don't miss your chance to experience the best of both elegance and nature-schedule your private tour today!
